items.en: "I've seen things you wouldn't believe. Attack ships on fire off the Orion-Perseus abyss..."
"May I bring a guest?"
"A hardened criminal who changed his name and became a Knight of Ludd."
"A man who broke his Knightly vows only to hide among terrorists and become a hermit."
"A Knight who lost his way - but never his faith - now seeking absolution by way of epic quest."
"We'll meet you before long, I'm sure."
"Relax, $global.jethroName. We're just making you more exciting for Menes."
"You knew what this would entail. Think of the good it will accomplish."
"We should steal the glove."
"Let's discuss the heist option again."
"I'll pretend to be a collector looking to buy a unique item."
"I could pretend to have a relic to sell. Any ideas?"
"Let's discuss me posing as a buyer again."
"I should invite Horus Yaribay to this 'gathering'."
"Let's discuss inviting Horus Yaribay to this party."
"I'll simply send my marines in to seize the relic."
"Let's discuss the raid option again."
"He wants to appease the Hegemony. And Luddics are a significant demographic..."
"Then it's decided. I'll speak with Horus first."
"Let's discuss other options."
"I often find the direct approach the most effective."
"Don't tell me you've never stolen before, $global.jethroName."
"Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself."
"No one gets hurt. And it's a fake which they stole from your people in the first place."
"I could send a marine raid in to steal it so we don't have to."
"I could threaten to bombard the planet until Menes surrenders the relic."
"Fine. Let's think of something else."
"Then it's decided. I'll have tools, it'll be fine."
"Let's discuss other options before deciding."
"I've got the tools and the intel. I'll steal that glove."
"It's decided. I'll steal that glove."
"It could be expensive, however."
"What if I was?"
"Buy the relic from Menes? That could be expensive."
"Are you... proposing that I cheat Menes Yaribay?"
"If the Church isn't paying... you're asking me to pay."
"I am not exactly overflowing with credits at the moment."
"I may be rich, but you intend to destroy the glove, right?"
"It sounds like we should just steal the glove."
"I may not have credits, but I do operate an independent colony..."
"I may not have credits, but I am a member of the Persean League..."
"I do happen to know someone extremely rich. Rayan Arroyo."
"Let's do it. I'll pretend that I want to buy a 'genuine' relic."
"Let's discuss other options first."
"Not likely."
"Absolutely not."
"No."
"He'd hate everything about this scheme."
"I'm just surprised. It's a good idea, $global.jethroName."
"I too."
"I too." (lie)
"Does not a Knight use violence to stop from greater violence?"
"Exactly. Like Ludd, righteous with hammer and sword in hand!"
"It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements."
"Yes? What is it?"
"Aren't you opposed to theft? You swore an oath."
"It's a pretty good plan. And I have the tools."
"I, too, have my faith. Is that nothing?"
"Tell me what your plan is."
"You're not going to let this go, are you."
"If you insist, then."
"I'd like to discuss a matter involving Menes Yaribay."
"He might spark a religious conflict that could tear the Sector apart."
"He bought a sacred Luddic relic for his personal collection."
"How do you get on with Menes? Not well?"
"Oh, they know. They hired me to... handle it."
"Menes invited me to some kind of party to view this relic."
Say nothing.
"Again?"
"You need to keep better track of your cousin's schemes, huh."
Accept Menes Yaribay's invitation and shuttle to his complex
Meet Menes Yaribay
"This is $global.jethroName."
"Jethro Bornanew, a novice of the Knights of Ludd."
"Pleased to meet you...?"
"No need to be prickly, $global.jethroName, the man is being friendly."
"Charmed, I'm sure."
"Everyone, you say? Does that include the Luddic Path?"
"So, Ulmus was it? How do you know $global.jethroName?"
"Anything, you say? We'll have to talk later, Mister Pond."
"Menes, I believe you had something special to show me?"
"I'm certain this party will be absolutely unforgettable."
Allow Menes to pull you along
Enter the vault
Wait a bit
"He's overwhelmed... you must understand, Menes."
"Menes. We should let him be for a moment, don't you think? Menes?"
Gently pull Menes' away and ask about other items in the collection
"Astounding. Makes one think how we would handle the Cold Passage. Menes?"
"Incredible. What would it take to persuade you to hold a tasting? Menes?"
"Fascinating. Do you think Leonis shot anyone with this, Menes?"
"Intriguing. I wonder if I might find more such xenolife on the fringe. Menes?"
Smile and nod
Follow Menes
"$global.jethroName! Restrain yourself, man!"
"He's only touched it, no need for-"
(whisper) "This'll make a great story."
Try to remain standing
"What in Ludd's seven hells was that?"
"What went wrong?"
"You had a fake glove? This whole time?"
"Good work, $global.jethroName. Great work, in fact."
"Next time, be sure to let me in on your plan."
"... Praise Ludd."
"Well I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!"
"I, too, feel its call. Would you consider selling the piece?"
"The Knight has a point, Menes. I couldn't make an offer without verification."
"Let's discuss veracity. I need... reassurance."
"Considering my offer, I require full confidence in the item."
"Let's discuss credits. Would a half-million open the question of a sale?"
"Let's discuss credits. Would 700k open the question of a sale?"
"Let's not waste time. One million credits."
"Outrageous. I couldn't imagine it's worth more than 800,000."
"I'll consider a million. But only if it's real."
"You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity..."
"Who sold you the glove?"
"Ulmus Pond sold you the glove, didn't he."
"I'll need to have the glove tested."
"That wouldn't be quite sufficient..."
"Precisely. Well put, $global.jethroName."
"I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 200,000 credits."
"I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 225,000 credits."
"I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 250,000 credits."
"Surely my status as a fellow demarch of the League means something."
"It may not be part of the League, but as a fellow executive of an independent colony..."
"My commissioned status with the Persean League must count for something."
"Your cousin Horus Yaribay trusted me with his diplomatic credentials..."
"$global.jethroName, will you explain why this is necessary?"
"I have a financial backer, Rayan Arroyo..." (lie)
"In fact, the Church is backing my purchase." (lie)
"Sorry, more spacer humor. The Church truly is backing my bid." (commit)
"Absolutely. I wasn't supposed to tell, but it's why I'm here." (commit)
"No, no, just a little joke. My apologies." (back off)
"It does?"
"What's your read on Pond?"
"$global.jethroName. $global.jethroName, can you finish my drink? I can't."
Shuttle down with Horus Yaribay to Menes' compound.
Watch the fallout
"And it's almost certainly a fake."
Keep your mouth shut, for now
Take the glove
Just take the glove already
Hesitate
Tuck the glove into a pocket
Carry it openly back to the party
Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew and leave
Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew
"Hello $global.jethroName. I think we should go now."
"Yup. Have a look for yourself." (give him the glove)
"I do. Did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?"
"Here, you take it."
"Perhaps you're right."
"Maybe. But did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?"
"Don't worry. Menes is going to be on his best good behavior from here on out."
"I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!"
Call in the raid
"Perhaps, Menes, we should take cover..."
"I don't suppose we could ask Menes."
"What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?"
"We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes puts the pieces together here."
"We're not registered with traffic control, correct?"
"Then we'd better go fast when we go."
Break orbit
"I'm still consulting with experts. Top experts."
"I was nearly killed at your 'party', Menes. We were both there."
"I'm truly sorry to hear that. I wanted to check in..."
"Is this about losing the... relic?"
"Perhaps I should comms another time..."
"You wouldn't happen to know where I could find Ulmus Pond, would you?"
(gasp and look shocked)
"Your chief could be covering for their own massive security failure."
"Now that you mention it, that Ulmus Pond seemed a little off..."
"I haven't seen him since your party."
"I haven't seen him since your party." (lie)
"He's dead. On Chalcedon. A Pather called Sedge shot him."
"I caught him. He promised to confess everything to you."
"I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Knights hold him now."
"I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Path has him now."
"Of course. I'll, um, let you go now." (Cut the link)
"I'll do that. And I'll, um, let you go now." (Cut the link)
"I'll... let you go now." (Cut the comm link)
"What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?"
"I don't suppose we could ask Menes."
"Thanks. What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?"
"I feel like we've worn out our welcome here anyway."
"We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes starts asking questions."
Use Bornanew's authority to meet with a nanoforge engineer
"I need an object analyzed. Very closely."
Shuttle to the engineer's laboratory
Watch closely
"What's this tell us?"
"Which are?"
"What forge made this? Where's it from?"
"So you can match the 'drift' to the forge."
"Can drift be obscured, faked?"
"So it's not a known forge."
"Can drift be obscured, faked?"
"Anything else?"
DEV set player.ethosCynical to 2
DEV set player.ethosMercenary to 2
"$global.jethroName?"
"Of course." (pay)
"You serve the Church. Is this not corruption, $jethroName?"
"Out with it, $global.jethroName."
"Guess we're going back to Olinadu."
"I'll handle it. I can be very discreet."
"I'll handle it. I can be very persuasive."
Open the comm link
"You're sure. How do you know this?"
"Your oath. Of course."
"Does an innocent man run?"
"Then we follow."
"Nav, set a course."
"What's Ulmus Pond's role? What does finding him do for us?"
"What if these are pirates, or a major faction misleading us?"
"Before we act, let us speak of your Knights' 'sources'."
"Could your queries have revealed our intentions?"
"If we're quick, we won't need to pray." (cut the link)
Find where Ulmus Pond is hiding
"Tactical, prep a shuttle. Let's have a chat with Ulmus Pond."
"I'll be the bad guy."
"You be the bad guy."
"I'm ready."
"You're sure he's here?"
"Don't you forget it."
Find a way upstairs
"More than worried. He suspects you, Pond. We're going to get answers."
